Olivia Chen: Quick check — we doing a 20m rapid rehearsal tomorrow at 10:30 PT? Need mic checks + failover cue.
Jason M: yes, 10:30 PT works for me. running order same as runbook?
Mia Patel: we trimmed to 18m total: 2m intros, 10m demo, 4m q&a, 2m CTA.
Sam Rivera: can we add a 30s buffer between demo and q&a for unmuting and rapid followups? :+1:
Olivia Chen: good call. buffer added. I'll update the run-of-show doc.
Olivia Chen: Quick cue list:
```
00:00 - ON STAGE - host intro (Olivia)
02:00 - Speaker 1 (Jason) share screen, demo start
12:00 - Demo ends, handoff to host
12:30 - buffer/unmute
13:00 - Q&A
16:00 - CTA + closing
```
Jason M: FYI — demo env will use dedicated endpoint, show perf numbers (p95 latency, tokens/sec). I'll paste metrics during demo.
Mia Patel: @Sam can you be backstage MC to watch chat for product ask escalation? I'll handle lead routing.
Sam Rivera: sure — will flag priority questions with :pushpin:
deploy-bot: Reminder: webinar streaming test scheduled 2026-04-22 09:45 PT. Auto mute checks will run.
Olivia Chen: rehearsal checklist: mics, screenshare auth, demo creds, fallback slide. Anyone want a dry-run earlier?
Jason M: I'd like 15m dry-run at 9:45 PT.
Mia Patel: I'll be there. I'll also simulate a failed model call so we can test fallback slide.
Olivia Chen: perfect — adding that to calendar invite. Thanks team :rocket:
